•Continued to enhance an AI Chat feature via the LINE 
application, enabling customers to conveniently access 
product information and receive recommendations easily 
through digital channels.
•Published the Sustainability Report 2025 and the 
Annual Report 2025 on the Company’s website to 
transparently and systematically disclose performance 
related to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) 
aspects.
•Received the Top Innovative Company Award from 
BUSINESS+ Magazine, at the Thailand Top Company 
Awards 2026.
•Received the Thailand’s Most Admired Company 
Award 2025 -2026 in the Management and Sustainable 
Development Dimension from BrandAge .•Developed physical and mental health assessment 
features on the TLI Application.
•Committed to providing financial and life insurance 
knowledge through Creating Shared Value (CSV) 
initiatives, including the “TLI: Enhancing Opportunity, 
Creating Careers” project (4thYear); the “TLI: Sports 
Showcase” project (8thYear); and the “TLI: Read for 
Life” project (5thYear).
•Organized blood donation activities under the “Love 
for Life: Blood for All” campaign (38thYear) , 
collecting a total of 1,618,400 cc of blood from 4,046 
donors in Q1/2026.•Received Organization Carbon Footprint registration 
certification .
•Committed to exploring innovations and 
technologies to achieve Net Zero GHG emissions , 
including the installation of solar panels.
•Encouraged employee participation in waste 
management by installing general and recycling bins at 
the headquarter and organizing the “SWAP SHOP 
MARKET”.
•Encouraged customers to participate in reducing GHG 
emissions by adopting e -Services including “e -
Receipt” and “e -Document” features on the TLI 
application to reduce paper usage.
The Company targets a 3% reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in 2026 and is committed to achieving Net Zero by 2050 .
